name: San Martín
shape: geoBoundaries, the department it is named for

notes: Mendoza's high-altitude districts of Luján de Cuyo and the Uco Valley are the source of Argentina's most highly rated Malbec.

blurb.text: A wine area in Mendoza. Plantings are led by Cereza (18%), Criolla Grande (16%) and Bonarda (13%).
